orig_k_clauses_clean: Leica runs.

orig_k_clauses_clean: The violent thumping of her heart drowns out all other sounds; her lungs crave oxygen; her limbs can barely lift, and it wouldn't be surprising if she were to stop moving at any second.

orig_k_clauses_clean: Nevertheless, she keeps running.
For the sake of saving her children.
Or maybe--there is something else pushing her.

orig_k_clauses_clean: She keeps running in the infinite distance that will never reach them--
blocks.orig_clean_en: She keeps running in the infinite distance that will never reach them--
blocks.orig_raw_en: She keeps running in the infinite distance that　　　　　will never reach them――

orig_k_clauses_clean: Just what is driving her to do so?
She wants to save her loved ones--yet something else is oppressing her heart, rivaling her desire.
What is the nature of this chilling, scorching, severe, and intense pain?

orig_k_clauses_clean: Finally, her heart has submitted.
The moment her spirit breaks, her body also collapses.

orig_k_clauses_clean: "That is the motor suit my mom invented during her younger days. Right, I would say it's the 'ancestor' of what I'm about to show you."
blocks.orig_clean_en: "That is the motor suit my mom invented during her younger days. Right, I would say it's the 'ancestor' of what I'm about to show you."
blocks.orig_raw_en: "That is the motor suit my mom　invented during her younger days.　Right, I would say it's the 'ancestor'　of what I'm about to show you."

orig_k_clauses_clean: "Lady Leica, this way. This is the item you requested......"
blocks.orig_clean_en: "Lady Leica, this way. This is the item you requested......"
blocks.orig_raw_en: "Lady Leica, this way. This is the item　you requested......"

orig_k_clauses_clean: "How do you like it?"
blocks.orig_clean_en: "How do you like it?"
blocks.orig_raw_en: "How do you like it?"

orig_k_clauses_clean: "......It's flawless. I have zero complaints."
blocks.orig_clean_en: "......It's flawless. I have zero complaints."
blocks.orig_raw_en: "......It's flawless. I have zero complaints."

orig_k_clauses_clean: "Anti-Magical Combat Battle Suit Metatron--the supreme item worthy of the name of the King of Angels."
blocks.orig_clean_en: "Anti-Magical Combat Battle Suit Metatron--the supreme item worthy of the name of the King of Angels."
blocks.orig_raw_en: "Anti-Magical Combat Battle Suit　Metatron――the supreme item　worthy of the name of the King　of Angels."

orig_k_clauses_clean: "......I can't thank you enough."
blocks.orig_clean_en: "......I can't thank you enough."
blocks.orig_raw_en: "......I can't thank you enough."

orig_k_clauses_clean: "But...... Why all of a sudden? You no longer have a reason to fight......"
blocks.orig_clean_en: "But...... Why all of a sudden? You no longer have a reason to fight......"
blocks.orig_raw_en: "But...... Why all of a sudden? You no　longer have a reason to fight......"

orig_k_clauses_clean: "No, there is."
blocks.orig_clean_en: "No, there is."
blocks.orig_raw_en: "No, there is."

orig_k_clauses_clean: "......Because we have regained that."
blocks.orig_clean_en: "......Because we have regained that."
blocks.orig_raw_en: "......Because we <FONT COLOR="#FFFF00">have regained that</FONT>."

orig_k_clauses_clean: "We can't just force everything on Kurou and Al anymore...... right?"
blocks.orig_clean_en: "We can't just force everything on Kurou and Al anymore...... right?"
blocks.orig_raw_en: "We can't just force everything on　Kurou and Al anymore...... right?"

orig_k_clauses_clean: "Which is why you went as far as retrieving it...... am I wrong, Ruri?"
blocks.orig_clean_en: "Which is why you went as far as retrieving it...... am I wrong, Ruri?"
blocks.orig_raw_en: "Which is why you went as far as　retrieving <FONT COLOR="#FFFF00">it</FONT>...... am I wrong, Ruri?"

orig_k_clauses_clean: "......You knew all along, huh?"
blocks.orig_clean_en: "......You knew all along, huh?"
blocks.orig_raw_en: "......You knew all along, huh?"

orig_k_clauses_clean: "That goes without saying. I mean, given that this is the 'story' we inhabit, it can't possibly be the only one left out......."

blocks.orig_raw_en: "That goes without saying. I mean,　given that this is the 'story' we　inhabit, it can't possibly be the only　one left out......."

orig_k_clauses_clean: "Yes..... Just as you said."
blocks.orig_clean_en: "Yes..... Just as you said."
blocks.orig_raw_en: "Yes..... Just as you said."

orig_k_clauses_clean: "......Jeez. Even for a big spender like the Hadou Enterprise-- reconstructing such a base is excessively peculiar."
blocks.orig_clean_en: "......Jeez. Even for a big spender like the Hadou Enterprise-- reconstructing such a base is excessively peculiar."
blocks.orig_raw_en: "......Jeez. Even for a <FONT COLOR="#FFFF00">big spender</FONT> like　the Hadou Enterprise――　reconstructing such a base is　excessively peculiar."

orig_k_clauses_clean: "--That's true. Its sheer monthly maintenance costs alone can feed a small nation."
blocks.orig_clean_en: "--That's true. Its sheer monthly maintenance costs alone can feed a small nation."
blocks.orig_raw_en: "――That's true. Its sheer monthly　maintenance costs alone can feed a　small nation."

orig_k_clauses_clean: "......This is crazy."
blocks.orig_clean_en: "......This is crazy."
blocks.orig_raw_en: "......This is crazy."

orig_k_clauses_clean: "--Do you hate this sort of thing, Sonia?"
blocks.orig_clean_en: "--Do you hate this sort of thing, Sonia?"

orig_k_clauses_clean: "Well...... I'm pretty eccentric too."

blocks.orig_raw_en: "Well...... I'm pretty eccentric too."

orig_k_clauses_clean: "[Toy Re-Animator] system is all green...... Phew. Now, let's wrap this up, shall we?"
